params.body:
#334 was merged while its CI was still running, and the PHPStan step failed with three errors, so `main` is red now:

- `client?->name ?? ''`: a nullsafe access on the left side of `??` is unnecessary, so it's now `client->name ?? ''`
- two errors from the closure type in `mapWithKeys`: the grouping is now a plain loop into an array

Same behaviour: clients in alphabetical order, Internal last, asks first within a client.

Run locally: Pint passed, PHPStan 0 errors, tests 584/585 (the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which only fails in a worktree and passes in CI).
params.title: Workbench per client passes PHPStan
